_: The eight zones of The Drowned Bell, and the expansion each is built at.
A grammar program is region-polymorphic, so a program file alone says nothing about
how big this campaign's zone is. This file says it, which is what lets a machine
expand and judge these programs without a person reading a design page first.
`delve-grammar audit --campaign-root <content repo>` reads it; every program file in
this directory must appear here, and every entry must name a file that is here.
`traversable` is the claim that a body walks the zone from its approach face to its
exit face; `allow_falls` is the claim that the route descends and does not come back.
